Similarly, the government pension offset was brought forward in the interest of fairness for two income homes. Past in 1983, the knock-on effects of the WEP and the GPO remained even as the economics of Social Security have changed since. Representative Spanberger is a Democrat representing Virginia's seventh district in the US House of Representatives. She recently reintroduced the Social Security Fairness Act to eliminate the Windfall Elimination Provision and the Government Pension Offset. After a short break, she'll join me to talk about the provisions and the results of her survey of our constituents.
